headlines.text: Looking back to 2026, when Kris Statlander vs. Hikaru Shida settled things in a Lights Out Philly Street Fight match, serving as the night's main event on Collision, rated 7.71 ? a strong outing in a big night for the women's side of the roster.

Back on this day in 2020, Jungle Boy vs. Billy Gunn vs. Brandon Cutler vs. Christopher Daniels vs. Colt Cabana vs. Luchasaurus vs. Luther vs. Marko Stunt vs. MJF vs. Orange Cassidy vs. Peter Avalon vs. Sonny Kiss vs. Wardlow settled things in a Battle Royal match, closing out the card as the main event on Dynamite, rated 5.97.
Looking back to 2022, when Ruby Soho vs. Kris Statlander met in an Owen Hart Tournament Match, closing out the card as the main event on Rampage, rated 6.80.

secondaries.text: On this day in 2026, Mark Davis vs. Jack Perry met in an Owen Hart Tournament Match, in the show-closing main event slot on Dynamite, rated 7.39 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.
It was 2026 when Moxley & PAC & Ospreay touched down in AEW for the first time as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 6.57.
It was 2020 when Christi Jaynes stepped through the curtain for the first time against Hikaru Shida, appearing on Dynamite, rated 4.14.
